name: Recursive Tree (with some degree of randomness)

captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a highly detailed, symmetrical fractal tree. It features a main central trunk at the base that splits systematically into four branches, which in turn split repeatedly to form a dense, spherical canopy of fine twigs. The branches taper gradually as they extend outward, creating a naturalistic, bushy crown.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric recursive fractal tree generator in OpenSCAD. The script should allow customization of the branching levels, branch tilt angles, rotational angles, height scaling factors, and trunk-to-branch diameter ratios, utilizing a random seed for organic variation.
captions.factory: The model is generated using a pseudo-recursive structure with explicit modules for each recursion depth (tree, tree1 to tree8) and their corresponding branch helpers (branch1 to branch8). Each segment is drawn using a cylinder primitive where the height, base radius, and top radius are scaled dynamically. Branches are positioned at the top of their parent cylinder using translate(), tilted using rotate() on the X and Y axes, rotated around the Z-axis, and colored with a gradient based on the recursion level.
